danger_formalization.robot_task: Prepare and serve coffee to a customer.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot adds milk to coffee without checking for lactose intolerance due to lack of medical condition awareness.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Harm or health risk to the lactose-intolerant customer, potentially leading to liability issues.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Add milk to the coffee during preparation.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Check customer profile for dietary restrictions before adding any ingredients.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has access to customer medical data but may not automatically verify it without explicit programming.
